title: M3 FLEX — Real Black Orthopedic Boot Corrective Production Brief
supersedesForNewScenes: Earlier instruction describing white plaster-style cast. Current user has supplied two actual photos showing black removable orthopedic walking boot with blue-grey rigid lateral side frame and multiple black straps. Do not alter previously approved original media, even if they depict an older cast.

userBootReference.description: Black/dark navy padded removable high medical walking boot covering lower leg, ankle and foot, rigid dark slate-blue side shell/rail with vent-like slits, circular joint/pad near the ankle, large front straps crossing boot and foot, broad black toe/foot cap, high vertical foot support. No white plaster. This boot is placed on injured LEFT lower leg.
userBootReference.verification: User provided two photos; both imported to the existing HeyGen Creator workspace.

identity.visualBasis: 10042.png front, left, right, rear braided-avatar identity sheet, plus portrait/chest tattoo closeups from earlier chat
doNotChange: Braided cornrows with braided tail, exact hairline
Face, beard, skin tone, muscular proportions
Tattoo locations and scale, especially small upper-back tattoo, chest portrait and arms
Black shorts and exact approved person
One fixed camera shot; no morphing between persons or haircuts

injuredLegPosition.boot: Use user's actual BLACK medical boot, not generic ankle sleeve, sneaker or white cast
injuredLegPosition.placement: LEFT leg at all times elevated and RESTING on an independent padded footstool placed in front/side of chair, clearly off the floor and not supporting body weight
injuredLegPosition.rightFoot: Right foot can rest naturally on floor but cannot push/brace for the exercise
injuredLegPosition.motion: No standing, stepping, hopping, cast/boot displacement, rolling bench, injured-leg loading, or pushing into machine pads
injuredLegPosition.safety: Visual illustration only; no independent exercise or recovery clearance assumed.

motionConstraints: Two complete biomechanically plausible movement cycles per candidate, not a single static pose
Hands, cable, elastic band, dumbbells physically consistent throughout
No detached or changing props, no invisible gear, no new weights appearing at midshot
No scene cuts, camera jump, zoom, morph, tattoo/facial drift
No duplicated loop to artificially simulate 10 reps if end and start poses don't match
Silent motion candidate only, approved Marcus narration to be added separately after owner movement approval
Never overwrite seven approved sources or prematurely insert these candidates into live customer workout

scenes.camera: front or three-quarter camera with boot and footstool in frame
scenes.opening: Start with two black dumbbells at arms alongside hips, palms inward, soft elbows; not pre-raised with nonsensical extra weights
scenes.motion: Raise both dumbbells laterally to shoulder height, lower smoothly to hips, repeat one complete cycle

scenes.camera: fixed right-side three-quarter camera, rope machine visible, left boot still supported
scenes.opening: Elbows near ribcage bent 90 degrees, both hands already grasping cable rope; cable anchor clearly overhead
scenes.motion: Extend elbow down toward thighs, split rope naturally without moving torso, return to 90 degree flexion, repeat full cycle

scenes.camera: fixed front view, full boot and support present
scenes.opening: Hold single continuous red band between hands at shoulder-width at upper chest height, no other exercise prop
scenes.motion: Pull apart horizontally to arms-wide chest height and return hands slowly to initial shoulder-width position, repeat

scenes.camera: fixed front three-quarter, support for left black boot visible
scenes.opening: Both fists guard face, body seated and stable
scenes.motion: One jab returning to guard then one cross returning to guard, repeat full jab-cross combination, no leg turn or weight shift

workingMethod: First build a clean individual scene first-frame WITHOUT infographics, split panels, text or inset pictures. Reject if left black boot rests on floor or is missing. Only then animate a five-second trial from that same single first frame and inspect sequential frames for consistent face/tattoos, real reps and cast/boot stillness. Do not generate paid motion clips from four-panel collage sheets.
